python3 << 'EOF'
# FY 1984 data from Treasury Bulletin
total_marketable = 1176556  # in millions
treasury_bills = 356798
treasury_bonds = 158070
treasury_notes = 661687

# Calculate bonds and bills combined
bonds_and_bills = treasury_bills + treasury_bonds

# Calculate amount NOT attributed to bonds and bills
not_bonds_and_bills = total_marketable - bonds_and_bills

# Calculate percentage
percentage = (not_bonds_and_bills / total_marketable) * 100

print(f"Total marketable interest-bearing public debt: ${total_marketable:,} million")
print(f"Treasury bills: ${treasury_bills:,} million")
print(f"Treasury bonds: ${treasury_bonds:,} million")
print(f"Treasury notes: ${treasury_notes:,} million")
print(f"\nBonds and bills combined: ${bonds_and_bills:,} million")
print(f"Not bonds and bills: ${not_bonds_and_bills:,} million")
print(f"\nPercentage not attributed to bonds and bills: {percentage:.2f}%")
EOF
